_comment: Copy this input file into your demo directory, edit it, then run bun scripts/scratch-obeya.ts <path>/stage.json. The printed staged.json is output, not input. Full schema: ../../../../scripts/scratch-obeya.ts (header). Omit port to choose a free one.
_language: Use English for the interface and text below to match an English demo.
name: Example project
_plans: Paths and contents of plan documents created in the scratch repository. Replace the snippet with your own.

plans.docs/plan/example.md:
# Example project

## Workstreams

- [ ] **W1:** Prepare the demo.

_cards: Each key identifies a card for commands such as --say. Replace titles, body and conversation with your demo's content.

cards.title: Prepare the demo
cards.body: Show the progress of this work.
cards._state: working starts an idle worker; events below supply its conversation. Use waiting with need demo for a handover.
cards._events: Conversation entries in order: author is owner or worker; kind is the event type, such as say or talk.

events.author: worker
events.text: The example is ready to inspect.

cards._row: code_review makes the Review tab available. mode is the review setting; handover identifies the handover being reviewed. See the script header for other row fields.
